`nconnect models` reports a bundled fallback model as live even when Nebius's live list does not include it. Example: DeepSeek V4 Flash (`deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`) is a bundled fallback; when the catalog is built from a live list that contains only `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash`, the report still shows DeepSeek V4 Flash as in the catalog.

The cause is that membership is checked against the merged catalog, which includes the bundled fallback rows. Fix it so that a row from `buildModelRows()` has `inCatalog: false` when its model was not in the source list the catalog was built from (it can still be `inPicker: true`), and `formatModelsReport` flags such a model on its own line with the words "not in Nebius's live catalog". Models that are in the source list keep `inCatalog: true`.

This is a pnpm monorepo. Run one test file with `cd packages/tests && node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/<file>.test.ts`; do not run the whole suite. packages/cli imports @nconnect/models from its build output, so after changing packages/models run `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/models/tsconfig.json` from the repository root. Dependencies are already installed: never run pnpm, npm or any install command. Do not bump versions or edit CHANGELOG or the site/ folder.
